text: morgan_prod: Heads-up 1: the in-app quicklink for KB -> /kb/usage/limits#burst stopped resolving after the tidy. User reported a 404 from the product portal widget, not blocking but it breaks a customer help path. dev-docs-bot: nightly-scan: 4 broken anchors found in /kb/usage and /kb/ops -> https://internal-scans/3080011222 (auto-report) yara_docs: I can take this. Which anchors are failing exactly? Paste them and I'll patch aliases or add redirects. morgan_prod: From the scan: `/kb/usage/limits.md#burst` -> 404, `/kb/ops/maintenance.md#drain-nodes` -> 404. Looks like headings were normalized (lowercase + punctuation) in the last cleanup and we lost stable IDs. ashley_se: The SDK sample README references `#burst` in a code comment; we should either preserve the old anchors or update the sample. Prefer preserving old ids via explicit anchors so external links don't break. yara_docs: Agreed. Plan: add explicit HTML anchors above the normalized headers and update docs-redirects.yaml with mapping entries. Small PR per area so it's easy to fast-merge. Local checklist: run `docs-link-scan --anchors` and `make docs-preview` before pushing. peter_pm: Please add a one-line changelog entry — customer-facing links are involved and we want traceability for the comms team. If this blocks any scheduled help emails, we should patch the email links as a fallback. ashley_se: I can fast-review. Also volunteer to open the sample README quick patch if you prefer, @yara_docs. yara_docs: Opening PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/6088 title: "preserve-burst-anchor-and-drain-nodes-aliases". Adds `` above the "Burst limits" header and `` above the drain section, plus docs-redirects.yaml entries. Sample redirect snippet in PR: ```yaml - from: "/kb/usage/limits#burst" to: "/kb/usage/limits#burst-limits" - from: "/kb/ops/maintenance#drain-nodes" to: "/kb/ops/maintenance#node-drain-procedure" ``` ci-bot: queued checks for PR 6088: docs-lint, markdown-link-check, docs-anchors. morgan_prod: I'm going to also open a tiny front-end patch to fallback to the canonical anchor if the fragment 404s, but I'd prefer not to deploy both at the same time. If docs PR is merged first, I'll delay the front-end patch until after preview shows the fix. ashley_se: reviewed, left two tiny nits (YAML spacing). Nothing blocking. Will re-approve after nits fixed. yara_docs: addressed nits, pushed commit. ci-bot: PR 6088: checks passed. docs-anchors OK. preview build successful. morgan_prod: Verified in staging preview that the old fragment resolves. I'll hold the front-end fallback PR and schedule a CDN purge for `/kb/usage` path after merge to speed up propagation. dev-docs-bot: post-merge re-scan: no broken anchors detected for /kb/usage and /kb/ops. peter_pm: Confirmed help emails updated or safe. I'll close the incident with a note and add the changelog line to release notes. yara_docs: Adding a one-liner to CONTRIBUTING.md: "When renaming headers, add alias anchors or update docs-redirects.yaml to preserve external fragments." Filing a follow-up ticket to audit other freshly-tidied pages next sprint. morgan_prod: Thanks everyone 1: great quick turnaround. Closing loop.
